Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 708 PM EST Sat Nov 14 2026
 

- A narrow corridor of lake effect rain showers (briefly mixed with 
melting snow) persists into tonight, mainly along the southern Lake 
Huron shoreline.

- Mostly cloudy skies expected through the weekend.

- Dry weather expected area-wide Monday through Thursday with a 
steady warming trend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Inbound high pressure will try and scatter out the persistent low 
stratus into tonight with some break in the clouds noticeable on 
satellite. However, the maintenance of the NW flow and the cold 
airmass should support at least moderate to high coverage of lake 
clouds through tomorrow morning. Thus, MVFR ceilings are expected to 
prevail through the tonight period with help from a subsidence 
inversion. High pressure will try to break up high clouds tomorrow, 
but diurnal heating will again work to maintain higher degree of 
coverage throughout much of tomorrow afternoon. There may be some 
ceiling improvement to VFR late tomorrow afternoon, but confidence 
is not high. 

For DTW... Persistent NW wind will maintain MVFR ceiling with some 
variability in BKN to OVC into tonight and through Sunday. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

*  High for ceiling at or below 5,000 feet through tonight and 
   tomorrow morning.

&&
